# The trusted runner's upstream scoring dependencies, pinned by hash.
#
# Regenerate with:
#     uv pip compile --generate-hashes deploy/sn22-runner/requirements-upstream.in \
#         -o deploy/sn22-runner/requirements-upstream.txt
#
# Only four packages are asked for -- pydantic, numpy, pytz, tiktoken -- because those are the ones
# upstream's own scoring semantics depend on. Everything else here is a transitive dependency of
# those four, present so `pip install --require-hashes` can name an exact artefact for every byte
# that ends up in an attested image.
#
# Nothing here reaches the AGENT image, which is standard library only. See
# docs/DECISION-bittensor-not-in-the-room.md.
